scripts.db:endpoint: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --region eu-south-2 --stack-name dance-tutor-data-${STAGE:-$USER} --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey==\`ClusterEndpoint\`].OutputValue" --output text
scripts.db:migrate: AWS_REGION=eu-south-2 DSQL_ENDPOINT=$(npm run -s db:endpoint) node database/migrate.ts
scripts.test:db: AWS_REGION=eu-south-2 DSQL_ENDPOINT=$(npm run -s db:endpoint) vitest run db.test
